categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: Commercial Intelligence and Smart Healthcare. The Commercial Intelligence segment focuses on EAS (Electronic Article Surveillance), RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) products, and IoT solutions for retail, supply chain, and smart city applications. The Smart Healthcare segment provides integrated smart medical solutions including hospital information systems, regional medical collaboration platforms, digital health data management, and AI-driven medical services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include RFID, EAS, ESL (Electronic Shelf Label), IoT platforms, cloud computing, big data analytics, and AI, especially in medical AI cognitive engines. The company employs microservices architecture and cloud-native solutions for its smart healthcare platforms. Manufacturing involves production of RFID tags, hard and soft anti-theft labels, and related hardware, with a focus on innovation in RFID applications and integration with AI and IoT.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include large retail chains, supermarkets, apparel companies, 3C electronics stores, fresh food stores, jewelry, logistics, municipal asset management, hospitals, regional medical groups, and healthcare institutions in China and overseas. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with exports to over 70 countries including Europe, Americas, Middle East, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Zhejiang Province and production bases in Cangnan and other locations. It also has subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong, Sweden, the Netherlands, the United States, and Chile. Its products are exported globally to more than 70 countries and regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures RFID and EAS hardware products and provides integrated IoT and smart healthcare solutions, acting as both a producer of core components and a service provider for system integration and digital transformation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on transforming into a leading RFID full-industry chain enterprise, emphasizing innovation in RFID technology, AI integration, and IoT applications. R&D priorities include smart retail solutions, digital supply chain management, smart city applications, and AI-powered healthcare platforms. The company is also investing in cloud-native architectures, microservices, and expanding AI capabilities for clinical decision support and medical data analytics.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of RFID tags, anti-theft labels, IoT devices, and smart healthcare systems. The company also earns from software licensing, system integration services, and ongoing operation and maintenance contracts. Sales are conducted via direct sales and agency models domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading manufacturer of EAS hard tags globally and a significant RFID technology developer and producer. It holds a strong market position with a broad product portfolio and extensive international customer base. It competes with other RFID and smart healthcare solution providers domestically and internationally, leveraging its integrated hardware-software capabilities and innovation in AI and IoT.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 690.8 million, a 31.33% decline from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 501.5 million, showing a 42.64% reduction in loss compared to 2023. The company has total assets of about RMB 2.19 billion and net assets of RMB 579.8 million. Despite losses, the company is undergoing strategic transformation focusing on IoT to drive future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated IoT and AI-driven solutions that combine hardware manufacturing with software platforms to provide comprehensive smart retail, supply chain, and healthcare services. Its RFID and EAS products are recognized for high reliability and innovation, supporting digital transformation and operational efficiency. The smart healthcare segment offers personalized, scenario-based solutions with strong data integration and AI capabilities, differentiating it in the domestic market.
